svg.title: 中关村大融城 — current photo-based court and garden-plaza ground
svg.desc: One continuous source ground: source X increases left to right and image top is source Y+. Units: 100 per metre. Painted basketball end hand-redrawn from refs01/04/05/06/09/17/18. Native carrier geometry corroborates its centreline but game scoring remains unverified. The elongated A badge is a photo-constrained reconstruction, not a calibrated physical measurement. Dense border artwork reconstructs visible motifs with inferred occluded portions. R10 grey-cement open plaza uses refs02/03/21/22/24/25/26; the user requests a simple unfilled white three-point line, free-throw semicircle/bar and key outline on the open end. These added functional markings are explicitly not copied from the site photographs. Art terminates independently of the gameplay midpoint. R09: faint free-throw arc is flush to the reconstructed black-key edge; native longitudinal lane-tab positions and gameplay sidelines/baselines are added at the user's request, not claimed as surveyed photo markings. A apex now faces the pictured hoop (-source X). No centre line, centre circle or second coloured paint/logo zone. Reference-end R09 paint, white marks and A remain unchanged; open-end functional white lines follow the native nominal basket/court geometry.
